title: Cyclic Cipher
statementMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/91b468d78347fe8904bdab04bd29243f20376a13.png)

Senor Vorpal Kickass'o invented an innovative method to encrypt integer sequences of length $*n*$. To encrypt a sequence, one has to choose a secret sequence ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c1146bf07905465e664a906aeef2d536ae820df3.png), that acts as a key.

Vorpal is very selective, so the key should be such a sequence $*b*_{*i*}$, that its cyclic shifts are linearly independent, that is, there is no non-zero set of coefficients $*x*_{0}, *x*_{1}, ..., *x*_{*n* - 1}$, such that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/546797560358482102548e689f1d4f6a4f3f51f7.png) for all $*k*$ at the same time.

After that for a sequence ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ac0849a8b9d57bfad827eb6d0c43bded96bb2261.png) you should build the following cipher:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ab03a39943fa9203348006520bdfadd7973328b.png)

In other words, you are to compute the quadratic deviation between each cyclic shift of $*b*_{*i*}$ and the sequence $*a*_{*i*}$. The resulting sequence is the Kickass's cipher. The cipher is in development right now and Vorpal wants to decipher a sequence after it has been encrypted. You are to solve this problem for him. You are given sequences $*c*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$. You are to find all suitable sequences $*a*_{*i*}$.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/15dd0d7eb10161f8c844467763048bb5736c9340.png)).

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*b*_{0}, *b*_{1}, ..., *b*_{*n* - 1}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8523c91fc44afb64bd85979c8fd795932943eedd.png)).

The third line contains $*n*$ integers $*c*_{0}, *c*_{1}, ..., *c*_{*n* - 1}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/34928efa66264a17ac3e21237414236994ae968a.png)).

It is guaranteed that all cyclic shifts of sequence $*b*_{*i*}$ are linearly independent.

## Output

In the first line print a single integer $*k*$ — the number of sequences $*a*_{*i*}$, such that after encrypting them with key $*b*_{*i*}$ you get the sequence $*c*_{*i*}$.

After that in each of $*k*$ next lines print $*n*$ integers $*a*_{0}, *a*_{1}, ..., *a*_{*n* - 1}$. Print the sequences in lexicographical order.

Note that $*k*$ could be equal to $0$.
statementZhMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/91b468d78347fe8904bdab04bd29243f20376a13.png)

Senor Vorpal Kickass'o 发明了一种创新的方法，用于加密长度为 $*n*$ 的整数序列。为了加密一个序列，需要选择一个秘密序列 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c1146bf07905465e664a906aeef2d536ae820df3.png)，将其作为密钥。

Vorpal 十分挑剔，因此密钥必须是这样的序列 $*b*_{*i*}$：它的循环移位是线性无关的。也就是说，不存在一组不全为零的系数 $*x*_{0}, *x*_{1}, ..., *x*_{*n* - 1}$，使得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/546797560358482102548e689f1d4f6a4f3f51f7.png) 对所有 $*k*$ 同时成立。

之后，对于一个序列 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ac0849a8b9d57bfad827eb6d0c43bded96bb2261.png)，需要构造如下密码：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ab03a39943fa9203348006520bdfadd7973328b.png)

换句话说，需要计算 $*b*_{*i*}$ 的每个循环移位与序列 $*a*_{*i*}$ 之间的平方偏差。得到的序列就是 Kickass 的密码。该密码目前仍在开发中，Vorpal 希望对加密后的序列进行解密。请你帮助他解决这个问题。给定序列 $*c*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$，请找出所有合适的序列 $*a*_{*i*}$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/15dd0d7eb10161f8c844467763048bb5736c9340.png))。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*b*_{0}, *b*_{1}, ..., *b*_{*n* - 1}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8523c91fc44afb64bd85979c8fd795932943eedd.png))。

第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*c*_{0}, *c*_{1}, ..., *c*_{*n* - 1}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/34928efa66264a17ac3e21237414236994ae968a.png))。

保证序列 $*b*_{*i*}$ 的所有循环移位均线性无关。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数 $*k*$ ——满足使用密钥 $*b*_{*i*}$ 加密后得到序列 $*c*_{*i*}$ 的序列 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的数量。

接下来 $*k*$ 行中的每一行输出 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{0}, *a*_{1}, ..., *a*_{*n* - 1}$。按照字典序输出这些序列。

注意，$*k*$ 可能等于 $0$。
